title: u or ou? The rounded vowels
subtitle: Stage 0, lesson 5

steps.title: u or ou? The rounded vowels
steps.body:
This is the first sound that is really new for English speakers. u and ou are different, and they change the meaning of a word.

• ou = oo, as in food. Lips round and push forward. tout (all): too.
• u = ü. Say ee and, without moving your tongue, round your lips as for oo. tu (you): tü.
• eu = lips round, tongue forward, like her with a rounded mouth. deux (two): duh.

steps.title: Minimal pairs: one letter, different word
In Canada
steps.body: In Québec, short u, i and ou can become more relaxed: petite and lune sound slightly different from France. You will hear it in the app. For the exam, the clear standard sounds are what you produce.

steps.title: Speaking: Pairs out loud
steps.body:
Say these pairs. Make the two sounds really different: tu, tout · rue, roue · dessus, dessous. Then say Il est sous la table (He is under the table).

• Look in a mirror: for ü and oo your lips are rounded. For ü your tongue is forward, for oo it is back.

steps.fr: tu, tout. rue, roue. dessus, dessous.
steps.en: Model answer. Say it in your own words after.
